reason: A web plugin that adds a per-turn file-change panel with changed-file listings, diff viewing, file opening, and filesystem reveal actions.

summaries.zh: 为网页会话添加逐轮文件变更面板，展示文件列表和差异，并支持打开文件或在文件管理器中定位文件。
summaries.en: Adds a per-turn file-change panel that lists files and diffs and supports opening files or revealing them in the operating system file manager.

capabilities: Tracks file mutations from supported tool calls
Displays per-turn changed files and applied diffs
Opens selected files with the operating system default application
Reveals selected files in the operating system file manager through a loopback endpoint
